notes.title: RogueStone 2 has been Officially Cancelled..
notes.content:
Hello there,

I just wanted to let everyone who has been wondering on the status of RogueStone 2: Open World. Several years ago I decided to cancel this project but I never officially announced it. Now I am.

The reason for cancelling this project is my personal tastes in game making is different than popular opinion plus I have zero reach. Due to those two things, RogueStone 2 is now no longer.

I also won't be making any more games, and RogueStone 1 is all you'll have from me. It never did well, since when I released the game I had zero reach and it didn't go anywhere, made very little and now it's free to play so it doesn't generate any income anymore even though it made very little to begin with.

I won't be updating RogueStone 1 anymore either since it's free to play.

To keep this short.. Hope you enjoy what you did get from RogueStone 1 even though it's sort of a niche game and I was going to make RogueStone 2 a much broader game to appeal to a much larger audience. But, alas, personal tastes doesn't fit in with that broad sense of appeal.

Thank you. That is all..
